title: What are the signs that this person is for real?
header_line: Jose's analysis of a book we are still naming. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: If someone described a famous person to you, how would you know whether to believe it?

Jose said he wanted to go on a tangent and make the call more collaborative. I'm going to be calling on people a lot more, he said, and change the dynamic of me sitting here talking. I want everybody learning from each other.

He asked: who is the author? What would you say to someone? A student said: a visionary businessman who knew how to take hold of and grow businesses, made good connections, understood who he was, and wasn't afraid to speak his mind.

Jose added: extremely structured, with incredible habits, relentless. I think he conquered a lot of limitations in his life from early childhood. No task was ever big enough for him. He always thought of himself as a winner. He never stayed in a negative mindset.

He embraced challenges. He was consistent. He was very emotional, a roller coaster. His imagination was massive, and he used it as an instrument for strategic, out-of-the-box thinking. He was inspirational. He cared about people. He balanced how he felt in the present with how he visualized the future. He didn't dwell on the past.

groups.heading: What are the signs that this person is for real?

lines.text: Jose asked a student: if you met him and didn't know anything about him, what would you think? Probably with a grain of salt, the student said. I might have a hard time believing some of the more extravagant things. Jose said: I bet you would believe twenty percent of what came out of his mouth.

When you meet somebody extraordinary, Jose said, what do they have in common? Self-confidence. They talk about what they are going to do. They don't dwell on the past. You meet a crazy guy who talks a million miles an hour about what he's going to do, and you think: he's arrogant, full of himself. But what are the signs that he is for real?

What are the clues you leave, he asked, that people say: he's going to get it done? He has a positive belief system. There are signs that show that to other people, just as there are signs that you have a negative belief.
What do people see when they meet you?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write how people who meet you would describe you.
Write the signs that show you will get things done.
Write three habits that show your positive belief system.
Write what you do that could look like arrogance, and what is really self-confidence.
Write one person you will believe more, or less, after this.

check.q: What did Jose say extraordinary people have in common?
choices: Self-confidence and not dwelling on the past

check.q: What did Jose ask for about the author in this lesson?
choices: Who is he, and what are the signs he is for real

check.q: What did Jose say he wanted the call to be?
choices: More collaborative, everybody learning from each other

recap: Self-confidence, habits and a positive belief show others you are for real.
